name: pyne-worker
description: PYNE edge evaluate host — Python Cloudflare Worker. Full language toolchain lives in hoox-sh/pyne.

API_KEY.description: Shared secret for the `X-API-Key` header. **Required in production.** Generate with `openssl rand -hex 24`. Leave empty only for a locked-down local test.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional default **HTTPS** destination for Pine Script™ `alert()` / `alertcondition()` firings. Leave empty to skip outbound webhooks.

INTERNAL_KEY_BINDING.description: Optional mesh key for [trade-worker](https://github.com/hoox-sh/trade-worker) `/webhook`. Leave empty if you are **not** binding trade-worker in this account (first-time Deploy to Cloudflare®).
